edits.hypothesis: Generic problem-solving procedures organized by problem type (not task domain)—constraint problems, counting tasks, causal analysis, pattern application—provide scaffolding for systematic thinking while preventing implicit memorization of the evaluator's task structure
edits.targets_mode: reasoning errors where model rushes through logic or inconsistently applies rules across task types
edits.why_not_lower_lever: This is a skill file providing reusable procedural scaffolding separate from prompts. Skill is the right component because these are general heuristics the model references during reasoning, not wording changes.
edits.trigger_condition: Always included in system prompt; activates when model encounters a complex reasoning problem
edits.retroactive_check: (corrective) These tasks fail due to reasoning errors; generic procedures scaffold systematic thinking. (preservative) Passing tasks on web_of_lies, object_properties, shuffled_objects are unaffected—procedures don't override working solutions, only offer organization. (transfer) Applies to any reasoning domain: zero task-specific references means no implicit pattern-matching against task structure.
edits.regression_risk: Very low. Removed task-domain names entirely, replacing them with problem-type categories that apply universally. Passing tasks see only procedural scaffolding, no task-identifying triggers.
edits.mechanism: Generic problem-solving procedures organized by problem type (not task domain)—constraint problems, counting tasks, causal analysis, pattern application—provide scaffolding for systematic thinking while preventing implicit memorization of the evaluator's task structure

edits.hypothesis: Returning ONLY the ANSWER line (discarding preamble and trailing content) minimizes output verbosity and format ambiguity, since the grader extracts only the ANSWER: line anyway
edits.targets_mode: output format confusion from verbose extracted answers
edits.why_not_lower_lever: This is control-flow / output plumbing—structural simplification of what the harness returns, not wording
edits.trigger_condition: Always applied; whenever an ANSWER: line is found, return only that line
edits.retroactive_check: (corrective) Choice-format cleanup (F1 predecessor) worked on shuffled_objects; ultra-minimal output removes remaining context noise. (preservative) Passing tasks with clean ANSWER: lines lose nothing when extra context is stripped. (transfer) Minimal output is universally safer when grader only reads ANSWER: line.
edits.regression_risk: Very low. Simpler code, returns only what grader uses.
edits.mechanism: Returning ONLY the ANSWER line (discarding preamble and trailing content) minimizes output verbosity and format ambiguity, since the grader extracts only the ANSWER: line anyway
